SHRAVAN SINGH CHAUHAN
📞 +91-6360491802 | 📧 tech.shravan@gmail.com

Career Objective

Dedicated and disciplined Software Professional with over 10.5 years of experience in software development. Seeking a challenging position as a Senior Software Developer where I can leverage my technical, functional, and communication skills to contribute to organizational and personal growth.

Career Summary

9+ years of experience in Java-based IT software development.

Expertise in Java, J2EE, Struts, Hibernate, Spring, Spring Boot, Microservices, and RESTful Web Services.

Strong exposure to repository queries, database integration, and object conversion.

Hands-on experience with XML, SQL, and various databases including MySQL, Oracle, Postgres, Cassandra, Hive, Hbase and MongoDB.

Adept at working with Tomcat, JBoss, WebLogic servers.

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work cross-functionally with technical teams.

Technical Skills

Languages & Frameworks: Java 8/11/17, Core Java, JDBC, Servlets, JSP, Struts 1.x/2.x, Hibernate, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Batch

Web Servers: Tomcat

App Servers: JBoss, WebLogic

Databases: MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, Hive,HBase, Dremio, MongoDB

Web Technologies: JavaScript, jQuery, XML, AJAX, JSON

Build Tools: Maven, Ant

Version Control / CI-CD: Git, SVN, Bamboo, Jenkins

Testing & Logging: JUnit, Log4j

Other Tools: Eclipse, STS, SQL Developer, Studio 3T, pgAdmin, Kafka, Redis, Zookeeper, MQTT, WSO2

Platforms: Docker, Openshift, ALM, JIRA

Professional Experience



Nous Infosystems – Bangalore

Technical Lead | Dec 2022 – July 2025
Project: FDR (Fitch Ratings)

Developed Microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, MongoDB, Oracle.

Deployed applications using Docker Desktop and Bamboo.

Tools: Studio 3T, IntelliJ Explorer

Responsibilities : Worked as an Individual Contributor 

Involved in high level system designing using Java/ micro services design pattern

Involved in development migration for existing Application

Developing and implementing a timeline to achieve targets. Delegating tasks to team members.

Standard Chartered GBS – Bangalore

Senior Technical Specialist | Nov 2019 – Nov 2022
Project: CIB_CASH

Managed both upstream and downstream payment processing systems.

Built automated feeds and managed data ingestion with Kafka and Solace.

Tools: Dremio, Hive,hbase, Kibana, BitBucket, OpenShift

Responsibilities:

Involved in high level system designing.

Involved in development of Designing and coding.

Attending PO/BA meetings about project scope or any issues with features

Production support and resolving issues.

TATA ELXSI Ltd. – Bangalore

Senior Software Engineer | Aug 2015 – Nov 2019
Key  Projects: 

    TML_IOT

Designed IoT middleware services for integration with third-party systems.

Used Cassandra, Kafka, MQTT, and Redis with Java/Spring Boot backend.

Tools: WSO2, Tomcat 8.5, Maven

Responsibilities:    

Involved in development of Designing.



Involved in development of Coding.

Production support and resolving site issues.

Responsible for writing the DAO and Implementation classes.

     EducationUSAIndia – USIEF (Jul 2018 – Jan 2019)

       Built mobile application backend in Spring MVC and Hibernate from scratch level

PostgreSQL, Tomcat 8.0

   Responsibilities:    

Involved in high level design from scratch.

Involved in development of Coding.

Involved in testing integrated application with UI

     SLA – Evertz NMS Canada (Feb 2017 – Jun 2018)

Web-based SLA analysis system using Spring, Hibernate,JSP, and MySQL

       Responsibilities:    

Involved in development of JSP pages.

Involved in development of Dependency injection in spring.

Responsible for writing the DAO and Implementation classes.

Used Business Delegate, Dao, DTO Design pattern.

       Third Party Driver Development – Evertz NMS Canada (Sep 2015 – Jan 2017)

Developed SDK for generating JARs for VLPro using Swing

        Responsibilities:    

•          Involved in development of Coding.

Alchemy Software Solutions (Deployed in IBM) – Bangalore

Software Engineer | Mar 2014 – Aug 2015

Key Projects:

SXP-SCV – AT&T USA (Nov 2014 – Aug 2015)

Developed SCV module in Struts 2.0 and JSP to streamline customer interaction

      Responsibilities:    

Involved in writing automation test cases using Javascript Squish froglogic.

Telecom order management system using Struts 1.3, SOAP Web Services

Responsibilities:

•          Involved in manual testing.
